name: Camp Mourning Wood
source:
In CMW you take control over the illustrious El Presidente, as he's being send to an all female reform camp for troubled girls.

The game is a combination of typical summer camp activities like making friends, peaking in the showers and having fun.

However, not everything is as it seems and soon you'll be introduced to a world of mysteries, monster-girls, magic and a quest to save the camp from a terrible fate!

[From [url=https://exiscoming.itch.io/camp-mourning-wood]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
在《CMW》中，你将控制著名的总统，因为他将被送往一个专门为问题女孩设立的女性改造营。

该游戏结合了典型的夏令营活动，如交朋友、淋浴和玩耍。

然而，并非一切都像看上去的那样，很快你就会进入一个充满神秘、怪物女孩、魔法的世界，并寻求将营地从可怕的命运中拯救出来！

[来自[url=https://exiscoming.itch.io/camp-mourning-wood]Itch.io[/url]]
